correctness.rationale: The new statement is finite and its proof is fully constructive: 1404 faces, 486 legal collapses to dimension two, 217-by-540 exact integer triangle-boundary matrix in a spanning-tree gauge with three-dimensional rational cohomology nullspace, generators of the 1296-element wreath action explicitly checked on this cohomology, and complete signed Lefschetz computation for all 1296 elements. All 22 class sizes, traces and class constancy, as well as the 27-translation spectral character, are reproduced by the standalone verifier from definitions. The Hopf trace identity and rational character orthogonality justify the module and quotient conclusions. No finite-to-infinite inference is made.

value.rationale: The full rational symmetry character of a canonical 56-dimensional graph-topology module is a complete and motivated invariant: it contains 22 values beyond ordinary homology ranks, records negative and nonuniform traces, and determines translation and full-automorphism quotient Betti numbers. These are not routine isolated rank increments or arbitrary slices; the full automorphism group and all conjugacy classes are natural. The computation genuinely distinguishes 27-translation symmetry from all 1296 automorphisms.
